parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
But-2-ene reacts with $\text{KMnO}_4$ to form organic product, $\mathbf{Y}$.
$\mathbf{Y}$ does not react with $\text{Na}_2\text{CO}_3$.
A gas is produced when an excess of $\text{Na}$ is added to $\mathbf{Y}$.

parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.text: Describe the conditions for the $\text{KMnO}_4$ used in the reaction to form $\mathbf{Y}$ from but-2-ene.

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.text:
$24.0\text{ cm}^3$ of gas is produced when an excess of $\text{Na}$ is added to $0.001\text{ mol}$ of $\mathbf{Y}$, when measured under room conditions.
Assume that $1\text{ mol}$ of gas occupies $24.0\text{ dm}^3$ under room conditions.

Deduce a possible structure of $\mathbf{Y}$. Explain your answer.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
$\mathbf{Z}$ contains three types of atom: carbon, hydrogen and a halogen. The mass spectrum of $\mathbf{Z}$ is recorded. Fig. 5.1 shows a section of the mass spectrum at $m/e$ greater than 63.
The fragment at $m/e = 64$ is the molecular ion peak.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.text:
Deduce the number of carbon atoms present in a molecule of $\mathbf{Z}$ using Fig. 5.1.
Show your working.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: Deduce which halogen is present in $\mathbf{Z}$ using Fig. 5.1. Explain your answer.

parts.label: (b)(iii)
parts.text:
There are also peaks at $m/e = 29$ and $m/e = 49$.

Suggest the formulae of these fragments.
Deduce the name of $\mathbf{Z}$.
